objective: Reduce avoidable tool-contract and terminal-envelope failures before testing actual native ARE quality under unchanged equal budgets.
findings: Generic method_navigation advertises optional cross-operation properties without expressing operation-dependent prohibitions. Real Cli calls include class_name for runtime_status/list_methods and path for list_files: JSON fits the advertised schema, but strict downstream validators reject it.

Cli baseline spends its tool budget on invalid field combinations and invented method IDs without obtaining complete source. Existing terse closed-request errors provide no operation-specific schema guidance.

Cli index eventually retrieves one complete source method and selects its delivered read_id in fenced JSON with surrounding prose. Native final-selection strictly rejects the raw response as invalid JSON; no evaluator label has been read and no semantic correctness claim is made.

Canonical native raw-JSON-without-fences system guidance is conditional on source_context. This exact-method adaptation intentionally has no physical-line provenance source_context, so that extra guidance was absent. Do not invent a provenance adapter to bypass the distinction.

Closure index ends with a confirmed status200 generation,4799 prompt/512 output tokens and finish_reason length. Actual costs retained; public generation invalid under unchanged output cap. It had ten tool actions and three read actions.

Native terminal_submission cannot be enabled directly here: the native contract requires source_context. A future structured terminal must have a truthful source-binding implementation, not a fabricated flag.

Native finalization reserve already exists and may prospectively allocate final calls within the same11/65536 limits. It is not enabled in r1; assess equal-arm tradeoffs and offline behavior before any successor freeze.
